title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
The Professional Division of Spherion Mid-Ohio is partnered with an established and mission-driven non-profit healthcare organization in Richland County seeking a Chief Financial Officer (CFO). This is a hybrid position with a salary range of $125K – $186K, based on skill set and experience. Come join their leadership team!

This is a direct hire opportunity — never go through a temp-to-hire process. If selected, day ONE you are this company's employee!

Are you a Controller, Director of Finance, or CPA ready to take the next step into an executive leadership role? A respected, mission-driven nonprofit healthcare organization in Richland County is seeking a Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join its collaborative and forward-thinking leadership team.

As part of a forward-thinking and collaborative leadership team, you'll guide financial strategy, compliance, and operations in support of high-quality community care. Your insight and leadership will be recognized, valued, and make a lasting impact — starting day one.

Responsibilities:
Financial Strategy and Planning
• Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with the organization's mission and goals
• Lead the annual budget and long-term financial planning process
• Provide financial analysis to support strategic decision-making
Financial Management
• Oversee financial operations, including accounting, budgeting, billing, and revenue cycle management
• Monitor performance against budget and forecast; implement corrective actions as needed
• Ensure timely, accurate financial reporting to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies
Compliance and Risk Management
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations, including HRSA guidelines
• Maintain internal controls to safeguard assets and mitigate financial risk
• Coordinate audits and reviews by external agencies
Grants Management
• Manage grant finances, including budget development, compliance, and reporting
• Collaborate with program managers to ensure effective and compliant use of grant funds
Leadership and Team Development
• Lead the finance team with a focus on accountability, transparency, and growth
• Mentor staff and support professional development and succession planning
• Oversee hiring, engagement, and career development in compliance with employment laws and EEOC standards
Collaborative Relationships
• Partner with executive leadership and department heads to meet organizational objectives
• Build strong relationships with funders, banks, and vendors
• Model positive leadership and uphold organizational values across the team

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
  • Expertise in health care financing, billing (CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10), and compliance (HIPAA, Medicare, Medicaid).
  • Proficient in financial planning, budgeting, reporting, and grant management (HRSA).
  • Strong understanding of GAAP, accounting software, and overseeing AP, AR, and general ledger functions.
  • Ability to manage internal controls, address compliance issues, and collaborate with auditors.
  • Leadership skills for motivating teams, presenting financial data, and strategic problem-solving.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and collaboration skills to address financial challenges.
  • Commitment to ethics, confidentiality, and continuous professional development.
Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field (MBA or CPA preferred).
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive financial leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare or nonprofit setting.
  • Strong understanding of financial management, healthcare financing, and regulatory requirements (especially HRSA).
  • Proven track record in financial strategy, budgeting, forecasting, grant management, and audit coordination.
  • Exceptional leadership, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency with accounting software (experience in healthcare settings preferred).
What's in it for you?
  • A culture where your voice is heard and your contributions matter
  • Purpose-driven culture built on trust, inclusion, and teamwork
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Wellness Reimbursement Program
  • Tuition Assistance
  • 403(b) Retirement Plan with 3% employer match
  • Employer-paid Life Insurance
  • Employer-paid Long-Term Disability
Does this sound like the executive leadership opportunity you've been seeking? Apply with your resume today!

title: Self-Perform Themed Project Manager
description:
The Professional Division of Spherion Mid-Ohio is partnered with an established and growing construction company in Lakeland, FL is seeking a Self-Perform Themed Project Manager with pay range $75K-$100K + Bonus based on skill set & experience. Come join their team!

**This is a direct hire opportunity! Never go through a temp-to-hire process. If selected, day ONE you are this companies employee!**

The Themed Project Manager - is responsible for overseeing multiple themed self-perform projects from start to finish. This includes managing job costs, coordinating Client and equipment needs, and handling daily project operations. The role emphasizes man-hour (MH) based production tracking, change management, and generating Monthly Project Status Reports (MPSRs). Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously are essential.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Review projects with the Estimating Team to understand scope, exclusions, assumptions, and qualifications
  • Collaborate with the Project Executive (PX) to establish and manage project budgets throughout the life cycle
  • Drive project profitability while upholding safety and quality standards
  • Track all change events and submit Change Order Requests (CORs) in a timely manner; maintain a complete Change Order Log
  • Ensure CORs are properly managed to become billable Change Orders (COs)
  • Coordinate equipment resources with Superintendents, Foremen, and the Equipment Manager (owned/rented), ensuring alignment with budget and project needs
  • Prepare and submit submittals/shop drawings per project specifications
  • Submit monthly pay applications and invoices to Owners, CMs, or GCs
  • Generate and present Monthly Project Status Reports (MPSR) to leadership
  • Participate in regular project meetings as required by clients and job needs
  • Ensure completion of field documentation, including daily reports, toolbox talks, job hazard analyses, and other required paperwork
  • Assist with MH and material takeoffs for Change Orders as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management
Qualifications & Skills:
  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • Experience in self-perform trade work is required
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel
  • Willingness to travel to job sites, including overnight stays
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated leadership and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Reliable work ethic and ability to follow written and verbal instructions
Preferred Skills but not required – Nice to have:
  • Associate Degree in Engineering or Construction Management or equivalent experience
  • 30-hour OSHA certification or willingness to obtain within 90 days
  • Estimating experience is a plus
  • VISTA project/accounting software experience a plus
What's in it for you?:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Short Term/Long Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Health Savings Account
  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan)
  • 401K -match up to 4%
  • PTO
  • Six paid company holidays
